title: medicago × varia f. tianschanica
intro: Medicago × varia f. tianschanica, commonly known as Tianschanian alfalfa, is a type of perennial legume that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Tianschanian alfalfa include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
